<ic>Distribute funds to Mr Tyke to repay the loan used to re-open the pits of Enderlund. He payed 250thr which is what I want from the senate.<br><br><i>Proposed by Mitwold, seconded by Upwold</i>.</ic> 


===Overview===
* This motion was to repay the loan offered by Mr Tyke that the Senate used to [[Repair_Great_Pits_of_Ennerlund|repair the damage]] done by the Druj.
* Passed

===Date===
* Autumn 379YE.

===Progress===
*250 Thrones disbursed to Senator Mitwold.
